## 0.2.242

owes: none — the left panel's width is set by dragging its edge (`panelWidth`, 200–480 px, a new optional field of the per-person `shell.local_web` record that reads 264 when absent; new `POST /settings/web/panelWidth`; a *Panel width* row with *Reset* in Settings → Interface); every page that draws the panel for a signed-in person now loads `panel-sizer.js`, so those pages answer `script-src 'self' 'sha256-…'` and `connect-src 'self'` instead of `'none'` (the sign-in page, the setup wizard's frame and error pages keep `'none'`); no migration, no wire change, rollback safe (an earlier image ignores the field).
